question.text: Which SEBI circular provided explicit guidelines on construction methodology of commodity indices based on futures contract prices?

explanation.text: The Logic: The SEBI circular dated 18th June 2019 provided explicit guidelines on construction methodology of robust commodity indices based on futures contract prices for trading their derivatives. The Trap: The 24th March 2022 circular is associated separately with index options on commodity indices. Note: The September 2015 and January 2023 dates are included only as distractors. The pages checked do not characterise them beyond that, so do not over-explain.
